checkpoint_module_activation: checkpoint a PyTorch nn.Module to apply activation checkpointing without modifying model source code
disable_hook_during_backward: disable checkpoint hooks during backward recomputation to avoid unintentional recursion
register_pre_forward_hook: register a pre-forward hook on a module to initialize the activation checkpoint generator
register_post_forward_hook: register a post-forward hook on a module to exhaust the activation checkpoint generator
access_checkpoint_state: access checkpoint state for a module to check or modify enable_hook status
